text:
jenna-partners: Quick check — for the upcoming private-offer wave, can we lock on graduated pricing thresholds that trigger safeguards (auto-topup, soft-cap alerts) so customers don't hit surprise bills?

omar-sales: +1. Wanted thresholds tied to committed monthly USD and monthly tokens rather than flat SKUs. avoids edge cases for appliances. :thumbsup:

ria-gtm: thinking cadence for announce: include a short FAQ about what happens when you cross a threshold (grace period, invoice hold, auto-topup opt-in). We should own messaging to partners.

lucas-legal: need standard language for opt-in auto-topup and refund windows. propose: 7-day grace, ability to discount overage credits if Customer disputes within 30 days.

sam-platform: on infra side we can emit a webhook from billing when a cust reaches 80%/100%/120% of threshold. webhook payload: `{"customer_id":"...","threshold_pct":80,"metric":"tokens"}`. We can also programmatically pause burst capacity for Private deployments, if partner requests.

jenna-partners: nice. For marketplace private offers we also want a soft floor so partners can't list extremely low SKU that breaks renewals. Suggest a min-price anchor per hardware SKU class.

omar-sales: min-price anchor = helps field with predictable renewal upsell. Can we do graduated discounts by year: Y1 20% off commit, Y2 15%, Y3 10%? Keeps headline discount without permanent erosion.

ria-gtm: that year-over-year ladder works. We'll draft co-announcement language: "introductory commit discount scales down on renewal" and supply a migration path for customers to move to reserved capacity.

lucas-legal: confirm we need a clause for "migration credit" if Redwood proposes model changes that materially alter unit economics. We should predefine triggers (e.g., quantization/architecture swap).

sam-platform: operational note — Recommend two safeguards: 1) Billing webhook + rate-limited auto-topup toggle. 2) Model-variant fallback (cheaper quantized model) when cost spikes. Both require partner opt-in in PO.

jenna-partners: action items — Omar to own pricing schedule draft, Ria to own announcement FAQ, Lucas to draft legal opt-in verbiage, Sam to spec webhooks + fallback behavior. I'll coordinate with SI leads for enablement playbook.

omar-sales: I'll push a pricing spreadsheet by tomorrow EOD with sample scenarios (metered -> commit ramp, overage calc, renewal ladder).

ria-gtm: I'll prepare two FAQ variants: marketplace listing + direct private-offer doc.

lucas-legal: will ping for signoff once I have the opt-in text. small Q: do we want a customer-visible toggle for auto-topup?

jenna-partners: yes — customer-visible toggle + default off for enterprise via private-offer unless partner opts in. mention in listing copy.

marketplace-bot: Deployment note: marketplace listing validator passed for current draft. Reminder: include `commit_terms` field in offer metadata.

sam-platform: will add webhook spec and fallback config to the offer schema PR.

jenna-partners: Good sync. We'll reconvene after Omar's spreadsheet. Thanks everyone. :pray:
